post.summary: Create a DRAFT invoice or proforma invoice from a quotation reference
post.description: Unified Marketing creation endpoint. Requires actor section MARKETING, including ADMIN and APP_MANAGER actors; other sections return 403. Fetches full priced quotation from Marketing using the actor token. Requires active APPROVED quotation in the actor branch and COMPLETED status when a Work Order exists. dueDate, location, purchaseOrderNumber and purchaseOrderDate are required. Deadline cannot precede document date. Stores quotation prices, location and purchase order data atomically with header, items and history.

404.description: Quotation not found in actor branch

409.description: Quotation not approved or Work Order not completed

post.summary: Create invoice or proforma invoice from a quotation
post.description: Requires an active MARKETING actor in the authenticated branch (ADMIN/APP_MANAGER roles do not bypass section restrictions), matching the Field Service creation access policy. Body: quotationId UUID, kind INVOICE or PROFORMA_INVOICE, dueDate (YYYY-MM-DD), location, purchaseOrderNumber and purchaseOrderDate. Forwards the verified user token to Finance, which re-fetches and validates the active APPROVED quotation and Work Order completion, and creates a DRAFT document with quotation prices, purchase order data, audit history and server-generated number. Finance remains the source of truth.

201.description: DRAFT invoice or proforma invoice created

403.description: Only MARKETING section can create documents via Field Service

404.description: Quotation not found in this branch

409.description: Quotation not approved, Work Order not completed, or duplicate invoice

post.summary: Create an invoice or proforma invoice
post.description: Allows MARKETING, FINANCE and ACCOUNTING sections plus existing administrative roles. Requires an active authenticated user with an office branch. All operations are scoped to that branch; no branch or actor fields are accepted from clients. Both invoice kinds share one collection, so the kind travels in the payload of create requests and can be used as an optional list filter. Number and date are server-generated and must not be supplied. Invoice numbers use INV/YYYY/000001 and proforma numbers use PI/YYYY/000001; both counters are separate, scoped by branch, and restart each Jakarta calendar year. Updates and soft deletes use optimistic version checks and append history atomically. Creation accepts a purchase order payload with companyId, title, purchaseOrderNumber, purchaseOrderDate and items, and always starts at DRAFT. items is an array of 1-100 item size UUIDs: Finance resolves the catalog data and the current normal, sister-company or contract price of every item from Marketing for the given company; the client never sends prices or quantities. One requested UUID becomes one billed line of exactly one inspection unit, plus one maintenance unit when the item offers maintenance. No discounts are accepted. Draft status transitions require the approval endpoint. Finance selects the master tax effective on the document date and recalculates taxAmount (half-up, two decimals) and total, saving tax and taxSourceId. Document finalization revalidates the tax. Final documents cannot be edited.

403.description: Inactive user or no office branch

404.description: Document or quotation not found in this branch

409.description: Stale version, inactive/final document, duplicate number, or missing applicable Finance tax

post.summary: Create a DRAFT invoice or proforma invoice from an approved quotation
post.description: Requires MARKETING section and an active APPROVED quotation in the actor branch. Body quotationId must match the URL. Validates live Work Order status: if present it must be COMPLETED. Forwards quotationId, kind, dueDate, location, purchaseOrderNumber and purchaseOrderDate to POST /finance/documents/from-marketing with the user token. Finance fetches and validates the quotation again. dueDate, location, purchaseOrderNumber and purchaseOrderDate are required; dueDate cannot precede the document date. Creates DRAFT header and priced items.

201.description: DRAFT invoice or proforma invoice created by Finance

400.description: Invalid document kind, deadline or request body

403.description: Marketing access and an office branch assignment are required

404.description: Active quotation not found in this branch

409.description: Quotation is not APPROVED or its version and items no longer match Marketing

CreateFinanceDocumentFromQuotationReques.description: Quotation ID must match the URL. Requires MARKETING section, same branch, active APPROVED quotation and COMPLETED status when an active Work Order exists. Finance fetches the quotation using the forwarded token. Every invoice creation must carry the purchase order number and date.
